component.name: LLCV
component.summary: Low-latency viewer for HDMI capture devices

description.p: LLCV shows video and audio from USB (UVC/V4L2) HDMI capture devices, such as the AVerMedia Live Gamer ULTRA S GC553, with minimal delay. Stale frames are dropped in favor of the newest frame, and capture audio is played through PipeWire with a small, drift-corrected buffer.

ul.li: NV12, YUY2, MJPEG, BGR24 and P010 (HDR10) capture modes
HDR10 passthrough on Wayland, HDR to SDR tone mapping elsewhere
Immediate or VSync presentation with OpenGL
Audio-only mode, volume boost and background mute
Source-resolution PNG screenshots and live diagnostics
Wayland by default, with an optional X11 (XWayland) mode

description.p: First Linux release: V4L2 capture, OpenGL presentation, SDL3/PipeWire audio.
